newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean defector arrives in South Korea.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean defector arrives in South Korea.

text.p: A plane carrying top North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop arrived in South Korea on Sunday on a flight from the Philippines, state television reported.
Korea Broadcasting System broadcast live pictures of an Air Philippines plane landing at a military airport south of Seoul. It said the Boeing 737 aircraft was carrying Hwang.
Hwang defected in Beijing on February 12 and has been in the Philippines since March 18, but his whereabouts have been kept a tight secret.
